name: AI Robots & SEO
description: Manage per-bot AI crawler directives in /robots.txt for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended alongside automatic XML sitemap declaration and optional rich-snippet meta robots output in Bludit.

features.0: Individual Allow/Disallow toggles for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended
features.1: Automatic Sitemap directive pointing to your Bludit sitemap.xml or a custom URL
features.2: Live robots.txt output preview in the Bludit admin panel
features.3: Optional index and max-snippet meta robots tag in site head
features.4: Zero external dependencies and MIT licensed
